prerequisites: Basic knowledge of materials science as taught in the course "Introduction to Materials Science" (H01D0A)
"Metals: phase equilibria, solidification and heat treatment"

learning_outcomes.text: Lay a solid theoretical foundation for the study of the thermodynamic aspects of various materials production techniques.

syllabus_topics: Processes: unit operations and treatment schemes
Melting \u2013 converting \u2013 distillation \u2013 liquation \u2013 vacuum metallurgy
Example: steel converter and zinc recycling
Examples: slag-metal equilibrium - metal-gas equilibrium - deoxidation of steel
Seminar 1. Visit to a metal-producing company (FMV)
Exercise session 1. Setting up treatment schemes
Exercise session 2. Mass and energy balances
Exercise session 3. Thermodynamic equilibrium in metallurgical processes
assessment_rules: The evaluation characteristics and determination of the final result for the second examination opportunity are identical to those of the first examination opportunity as described above. The exam is an oral examination with written preparation, covering open questions, and a formularium is allowed.
bibliography: Cursustekst for introduction to lab session
institution: KU Leuven - Faculty of Engineering Science
degree: Bachelor in de ingenieurswetenschappen (Bachelor of Engineering Science, Leuven)
